text.en: Most customers praise Kristie, Chris, and the store team for their warmth, attentive customer assistance, and thoughtful guidance on plant and floral arrangements. Reviewers appreciate that the staff go out of their way to source items and prepare displays. However, one reviewer left a negative review regarding reckless driving by a delivery driver connected to the shop.

Shoppers describe the shop as a wonderful local treasure chest combining garden plants, flowers, and pet essentials in Crouch End. Reviewers value having quality floral displays and reliable pet items available within a welcoming neighbourhood shop. Visitors frequently remark on the pleasant ambience and variety of supplies stocked in store.

Pet parents highlight the shop's own-brand dry dog food and wide selection of tasty pet treats. One owner mentions that the grain-free food worked remarkably well for a dog with a delicate digestive system. Customers appreciate being able to pick up nutritious pet snacks while browsing the plant and garden aisles.

q.en: Does Hornsey Pet & Garden Shop sell pet food in Crouch End?

a.en: Yes, the store stocks its own brand of grain-free dry dog food alongside popular wet food mixes and pet treats.

q.en: Are floral arrangements and houseplants available at this store?

a.en: Yes, the shop incorporates Flowers By Kristie, offering bespoke floral arrangements for events, funeral tributes, and potted orchids.

q.en: Can customers arrange delivery for plants or flowers?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the shop coordinates delivery for plants and floral tributes across London.
